--                  @ip_week_ending_to replace HANA input parameters
--                  IP_WEEK_ENDING_FROM and IP_WEEK_ENDING_TO (both STRING,
--                  matching bic_zio_sweek STRING type in Columns_Mapping_v3).
--                  The seven upstream source views retain placeholder paths
--                  (see ISSUES TO FIX section in the description file).
--                  SFN_PRIOR_FISCAL_WEEK is not supplied; its usage is
--                  documented in the variableMapping section only and does
--                  not appear in any filter or calculation in the supplied
--                  converted SQL; no parameter substitution is required in
--                  the query body.
--                  All column names are in BigQuery style (lowercase, no
--                  leading underscores, / replaced with _).
-- =============================================================================

WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: FLASH
-- Logic: Selects all columns from the Flash (current-week actuals) source
--        view. No week-range filter is applied to this branch per the
--        converted XML logic.
-- Source: CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_STATIC (BigQuery path requires validation)
-- =====================================================================
FLASH AS (
  SELECT * FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_STATIC`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: FS_BUDGET
-- Logic: Selects all columns from the FS Budget source view, filtered to
--        the requested fiscal-week range.
-- Source: CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC (BigQuery path requires validation)
-- Filters: bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
-- =====================================================================
FS_BUDGET AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC`
  WHERE bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: SKF_BUDGET
-- Logic: Selects all columns from the SKF Budget source view, filtered to
--        the requested fiscal-week range.
-- Source: CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC (BigQuery path requires validation)
-- Filters: bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
-- =====================================================================
SKF_BUDGET AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC`
  WHERE bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: FORECAST_MJE
-- Logic: Selects all columns from the Forecast MJE source view. No
--        week-range filter is applied to this branch per the converted
--        XML logic.
-- Source: CV_COMP_FORECAST_MJE_STATIC (BigQuery path requires validation)
-- =====================================================================
FORECAST_MJE AS (
  SELECT * FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FORECAST_MJE_STATIC`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: FIN_LY
-- Logic: Selects all columns from the Financial Last-Year Actuals source
--        view, filtered to the requested fiscal-week range.
-- Source: CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC (BigQuery path requires validation)
-- Filters: bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
-- =====================================================================
FIN_LY AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC`
  WHERE bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: SKF_LY
-- Logic: Selects all columns from the SKF Last-Year Actuals source view,
--        filtered to the requested fiscal-week range.
-- Source: CV_COMP_SKF_ACTUAL_STATIC (BigQuery path requires validation)
-- Filters: bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
-- =====================================================================
SKF_LY AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_SKF_ACTUAL_STATIC`
  WHERE bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: RX_BUDGET
-- Logic: Selects all columns from the RX Budget source view (same physical
--        source as FS_BUDGET), filtered to the requested fiscal-week range.
-- Source: CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC (BigQuery path requires validation)
-- Filters: bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
-- =====================================================================
RX_BUDGET AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC`
  WHERE bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: FS_TOPSIDE_ADJ
-- Logic: Selects all columns from the Topside Adjustments source view for
--        the FS branch. No week-range filter applied per the converted
--        XML logic.
-- Source: CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (BigQuery path requires validation)
-- =====================================================================
FS_TOPSIDE_ADJ AS (
  SELECT * FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: RX_TOPSIDE_ADJ
-- Logic: Selects all columns from the Topside Adjustments source view for
--        the RX branch. No week-range filter applied per the converted
--        XML logic.
-- Source: CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (BigQuery path requires validation)
-- =====================================================================
RX_TOPSIDE_ADJ AS (
  SELECT * FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 10: COMBINED
-- Logic: Unions all nine source branches into a single row set. This
--        implements the XML UnionView node. All branches must expose the
--        same ordered schema; the SELECT * form is retained here because
--        the exact schema of each upstream view is not supplied (see
--        ISSUES TO FIX). When upstream view schemas are confirmed, each
--        branch must be written with explicit, type-aligned column lists.
-- Source: FLASH, FS_BUDGET, FORECAST_MJE, FIN_LY, SKF_LY, SKF_BUDGET,
--         FS_TOPSIDE_ADJ, RX_TOPSIDE_ADJ, RX_BUDGET
-- =====================================================================
COMBINED AS (
  SELECT * FROM FLASH
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM FS_BUDGET
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM FORECAST_MJE
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM FIN_LY
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM SKF_LY
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM SKF_BUDGET
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM FS_TOPSIDE_ADJ
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM RX_TOPSIDE_ADJ
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM RX_BUDGET
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 11: Aggregation_1
-- Logic: Aggregates the COMBINED union at the grain of the ten dimension
--        columns (mandt, prctr, zzweek, bic_zio_sweek, segment,
--        cal_comp_flag, budget_comp_flag, fs_rx_flag, fs_rx_flag_ext,
--        emerg_mkt_ind). Measures are summed; timestamp columns take MAX.
--        This mirrors the XML Aggregation_1 node and must occur before
--        variance calculations.
-- Source: COMBINED
-- Aggregation: SUM for all financial measures; MAX for timestamp measures;
--              GROUP BY the ten dimension columns listed above.
-- =====================================================================
Aggregation_1 AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    zzweek,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    segment,
    cal_comp_flag,
    budget_comp_flag,
    fs_rx_flag,
    fs_rx_flag_ext,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    SUM(fs_salesamount)          AS fs_salesamount,
    SUM(rx_salesamount)          AS rx_salesamount,
    SUM(reductionamount)         AS reductionamount,
    SUM(emp_reductionamount)     AS emp_reductionamount,
    SUM(cal_fs_sales_mje)        AS cal_fs_sales_mje,
    SUM(cal_rx_sales_mje)        AS cal_rx_sales_mje,
    SUM(sbt)                     AS sbt,
    SUM(cal_scripts_90as3_car)   AS cal_scripts_90as3_car,
    SUM(skf_mje_qty)             AS skf_mje_qty,
    SUM(fin_budget_amount)       AS fin_budget_amount,
    SUM(skf_budget_qty)          AS skf_budget_qty,
    SUM(fin_fcst_amount)         AS fin_fcst_amount,
    SUM(skf_fcst_qty)            AS skf_fcst_qty,
    SUM(fin_ly_amount)           AS fin_ly_amount,
    SUM(skf_ly_qty)              AS skf_ly_qty,
    SUM(rx_budget)               AS rx_budget,
    SUM(cal_rx_budget)           AS cal_rx_budget,
    MAX(fs_upd_timestamp)        AS fs_upd_timestamp,
    MAX(rx_upd_timestamp)        AS rx_upd_timestamp
  FROM COMBINED
  GROUP BY
    mandt,
    prctr,
    zzweek,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    segment,
    cal_comp_flag,
    budget_comp_flag,
    fs_rx_flag,
    fs_rx_flag_ext,
    emerg_mkt_ind
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 12: VARIANCES
-- Logic: Extends Aggregation_1 with all variance and composite calculated
--        columns defined in the XML logical model. Calculations use the
--        aggregated measure values from Aggregation_1.
-- Source: Aggregation_1
-- Calculation:
--   cal_fs_sales          = fs_salesamount - reductionamount
--                           - emp_reductionamount + cal_fs_sales_mje + sbt
--   cal_rx_sales          = rx_salesamount + cal_rx_sales_mje
--   cal_scripts_90as3     = cal_scripts_90as3_car + skf_mje_qty
--   cal_fs_bud_var        = fs_salesamount - fin_budget_amount
--   cal_fs_forecast_var   = IF(fs_rx_flag='FS', fs_salesamount
--                              - fin_fcst_amount, 0)
--   cal_fs_ly_var         = IF(fs_rx_flag='FS', fs_salesamount
--                              - fin_ly_amount, 0)
--   cal_rx_bud_var        = (rx_salesamount+cal_rx_sales_mje)
--                           - cal_rx_budget
--   cal_skf_forecast_var  = cal_scripts_90as3 - skf_fcst_qty
--   cal_skf_bud_var       = cal_scripts_90as3 - skf_budget_qty
--   cal_skf_ly_var        = cal_scripts_90as3 - skf_ly_qty
--   cal_fs_bud_corp_var   = cal_fs_sales - fin_budget_amount
--   cal_fs_forecast_corp_var = IF(fs_rx_flag='FS',
--                                 cal_fs_sales - fin_fcst_amount, 0)
--   cal_fs_ly_corp_var    = IF(fs_rx_flag='FS',
--                               cal_fs_sales - fin_ly_amount, 0)
--   cal_rx_forecast_var   = IF(fs_rx_flag_ext='RX',
--                               cal_rx_sales - fin_fcst_amount, 0)
--   cal_rx_ly_var         = IF(fs_rx_flag_ext='RX',
--                               cal_rx_sales - fin_ly_amount, 0)
--   cal_comp_fs_budget_amount    = IF(budget_comp_flag='1',
--                                     fin_budget_amount, 0)
--   cal_comp_corpfs_sales_amount = IF(cal_comp_flag='1',
--                                     cal_fs_sales, 0)
--   cal_comp_fs_salesamount      = IF(cal_comp_flag='1',
--                                     fs_salesamount, 0)
--   cal_comp_rx_salesamount      = IF(cal_comp_flag='1',
--                                     cal_rx_sales, 0)
--   cal_comp_budget_90as3        = IF(budget_comp_flag='1',
--                                     skf_budget_qty, 0)
--   cal_comp_flash_90as3         = IF(cal_comp_flag='1',
--                                     cal_scripts_90as3, 0)
--   cal_comp_forecast_amount     = IF(cal_comp_flag='1',
--                                     fin_fcst_amount, 0)
--   cal_comp_forecast_90as3      = IF(cal_comp_flag='1',
--                                     skf_fcst_qty, 0)
--   cal_comp_ly_amount           = IF(cal_comp_flag='1',
--                                     fin_ly_amount, 0)
--   cal_comp_ly_90as3            = IF(cal_comp_flag='1',
--                                     skf_ly_qty, 0)
-- =====================================================================
VARIANCES AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    a.fs_salesamount - a.reductionamount - a.emp_reductionamount
      + a.cal_fs_sales_mje + a.sbt
      AS cal_fs_sales,
    a.rx_salesamount + a.cal_rx_sales_mje
      AS cal_rx_sales,
    a.cal_scripts_90as3_car + a.skf_mje_qty
      AS cal_scripts_90as3,
    a.fs_salesamount - a.fin_budget_amount
      AS cal_fs_bud_var,
    IF(a.fs_rx_flag = 'FS', a.fs_salesamount - a.fin_fcst_amount, 0)
      AS cal_fs_forecast_var,
    IF(a.fs_rx_flag = 'FS', a.fs_salesamount - a.fin_ly_amount, 0)
      AS cal_fs_ly_var,
    (a.rx_salesamount + a.cal_rx_sales_mje) - a.cal_rx_budget
      AS cal_rx_bud_var,
    (a.cal_scripts_90as3_car + a.skf_mje_qty) - a.skf_fcst_qty
      AS cal_skf_forecast_var,
    (a.cal_scripts_90as3_car + a.skf_mje_qty) - a.skf_budget_qty
      AS cal_skf_bud_var,
    (a.cal_scripts_90as3_car + a.skf_mje_qty) - a.skf_ly_qty
      AS cal_skf_ly_var,
    (a.fs_salesamount - a.reductionamount - a.emp_reductionamount
      + a.cal_fs_sales_mje + a.sbt) - a.fin_budget_amount
      AS cal_fs_bud_corp_var,
    IF(a.fs_rx_flag = 'FS',
      (a.fs_salesamount - a.reductionamount - a.emp_reductionamount
       + a.cal_fs_sales_mje + a.sbt) - a.fin_fcst_amount, 0)
      AS cal_fs_forecast_corp_var,
    IF(a.fs_rx_flag = 'FS',
      (a.fs_salesamount - a.reductionamount - a.emp_reductionamount
       + a.cal_fs_sales_mje + a.sbt) - a.fin_ly_amount, 0)
      AS cal_fs_ly_corp_var,
    IF(a.fs_rx_flag_ext = 'RX',
      (a.rx_salesamount + a.cal_rx_sales_mje) - a.fin_fcst_amount, 0)
      AS cal_rx_forecast_var,
    IF(a.fs_rx_flag_ext = 'RX',
      (a.rx_salesamount + a.cal_rx_sales_mje) - a.fin_ly_amount, 0)
      AS cal_rx_ly_var,
    IF(a.budget_comp_flag = '1', a.fin_budget_amount, 0)
      AS cal_comp_fs_budget_amount,
    IF(a.cal_comp_flag = '1',
      a.fs_salesamount - a.reductionamount - a.emp_reductionamount
      + a.cal_fs_sales_mje + a.sbt, 0)
      AS cal_comp_corpfs_sales_amount,
    IF(a.cal_comp_flag = '1', a.fs_salesamount, 0)
      AS cal_comp_fs_salesamount,
    IF(a.cal_comp_flag = '1', a.rx_salesamount + a.cal_rx_sales_mje, 0)
      AS cal_comp_rx_salesamount,
    IF(a.budget_comp_flag = '1', a.skf_budget_qty, 0)
      AS cal_comp_budget_90as3,
    IF(a.cal_comp_flag = '1', a.cal_scripts_90as3_car + a.skf_mje_qty, 0)
      AS cal_comp_flash_90as3,
    IF(a.cal_comp_flag = '1', a.fin_fcst_amount, 0)
      AS cal_comp_forecast_amount,
    IF(a.cal_comp_flag = '1', a.skf_fcst_qty, 0)
      AS cal_comp_forecast_90as3,
    IF(a.cal_comp_flag = '1', a.fin_ly_amount, 0)
      AS cal_comp_ly_amount,
    IF(a.cal_comp_flag = '1', a.skf_ly_qty, 0)
      AS cal_comp_ly_90as3
  FROM Aggregation_1 a
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 13: CONV_DRUG
-- Logic: Filters VARIANCES to rows where SEGMENT is NULL or equals
--        'CONVDRUG' (case-insensitive). This subset is used for ASP
--        calculations.
-- Source: VARIANCES
-- Filters: segment IS NULL OR UPPER(segment) = 'CONVDRUG'
-- =====================================================================
CONV_DRUG AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM VARIANCES
  WHERE segment IS NULL OR UPPER(segment) = 'CONVDRUG'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 14: TOTAL_ASP
-- Logic: Aggregates CONV_DRUG at the fiscal-week grain to compute total
--        ASP (Average Selling Price) metrics: budget ASP, flash ASP, and
--        ASP change percentage. Uses SAFE_DIVIDE to protect against
--        division by zero.
-- Source: CONV_DRUG
-- Aggregation: SUM of cal_rx_budget, skf_budget_qty, cal_rx_sales,
--              cal_scripts_90as3; GROUP BY bic_zio_sweek
-- Calculation:
--   cal_total_budget_asp  = IF(SUM(skf_budget_qty)=0, 0,
--                              ROUND(SUM(cal_rx_budget)/
--                                    SUM(skf_budget_qty), 2))
--   cal_total_flash_asp   = IF(SUM(cal_scripts_90as3)=0, 0,
--                              ROUND(SUM(cal_rx_sales)/
--                                    SUM(cal_scripts_90as3), 2))
--   cal_asp_change_perct  = IF(cal_total_budget_asp=0, 0,
--                              ROUND(cal_total_flash_asp/
--                                    cal_total_budget_asp - 1, 4))
-- =====================================================================
TOTAL_ASP AS (
  SELECT
    bic_zio_sweek,
    SUM(cal_rx_budget)        AS cal_rx_budget,
    SUM(skf_budget_qty)       AS skf_budget_qty,
    SUM(cal_rx_sales)         AS cal_rx_sales,
    SUM(cal_scripts_90as3)    AS cal_scripts_90as3,
    IF(SUM(skf_budget_qty) = 0, 0,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(cal_rx_budget), SUM(skf_budget_qty)), 2))
      AS cal_total_budget_asp,
    IF(SUM(cal_scripts_90as3) = 0, 0,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(cal_rx_sales), SUM(cal_scripts_90as3)), 2))
      AS cal_total_flash_asp,
    IF(
      IF(SUM(skf_budget_qty) = 0, 0,
         ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(cal_rx_budget), SUM(skf_budget_qty)), 2)) = 0,
      0,
      ROUND(
        SAFE_DIVIDE(
          IF(SUM(cal_scripts_90as3) = 0, 0,
             ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(cal_rx_sales), SUM(cal_scripts_90as3)), 2)),
          IF(SUM(skf_budget_qty) = 0, 0,
             ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(cal_rx_budget), SUM(skf_budget_qty)), 2))
        ) - 1,
        4
      )
    ) AS cal_asp_change_perct
  FROM CONV_DRUG
  GROUP BY bic_zio_sweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 15: STORE_FLASH
-- Logic: Aggregates CONV_DRUG at the profit-center + fiscal-week grain,
--        restricted to rows where cal_rx_budget is zero or NULL (i.e.,
--        stores without a pre-allocated RX budget). Computes store-level
--        flash ASP.
-- Source: CONV_DRUG
-- Filters: cal_rx_budget = 0 OR cal_rx_budget IS NULL
-- Aggregation: SUM of cal_rx_sales, cal_scripts_90as3;
--              GROUP BY prctr, bic_zio_sweek
-- Calculation:
--   cal_store_flash_asp = IF(SUM(cal_scripts_90as3)=0, 0,
--                            ROUND(SUM(cal_rx_sales)/
--                                  SUM(cal_scripts_90as3), 2))
-- =====================================================================
STORE_FLASH AS (
  SELECT
    prctr,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    SUM(cal_rx_sales)       AS cal_rx_sales,
    SUM(cal_scripts_90as3)  AS cal_scripts_90as3,
    IF(SUM(cal_scripts_90as3) = 0, 0,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(cal_rx_sales), SUM(cal_scripts_90as3)), 2))
      AS cal_store_flash_asp
  FROM CONV_DRUG
  WHERE cal_rx_budget = 0 OR cal_rx_budget IS NULL
  GROUP BY prctr, bic_zio_sweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 16: Join_4
-- Logic: Left-outer-joins STORE_FLASH with TOTAL_ASP on bic_zio_sweek
--        to bring total-level ASP metrics into the store-level dataset.
--        Implements XML Join_4 (joinType=leftOuter, key=bic_zio_sweek).
-- Source: STORE_FLASH (left), TOTAL_ASP (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN STORE_FLASH s JOIN TOTAL_ASP t USING (bic_zio_sweek)
-- =====================================================================
Join_4 AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    t.cal_total_budget_asp,
    t.cal_total_flash_asp,
    t.cal_asp_change_perct
  FROM STORE_FLASH s
  LEFT JOIN TOTAL_ASP t
    USING (bic_zio_sweek)
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 17: ADJUSTED_ASP
-- Logic: Computes the adjusted ASP per store by dividing the store flash
--        ASP by (1 + ASP change percentage). Handles the edge case where
--        cal_asp_change_perct = -1 (would cause division by zero) by
--        returning 0.
-- Source: Join_4
-- Calculation:
--   cal_asp_adj_amount = IF(cal_asp_change_perct = -1, 0,
--                           ROUND(cal_store_flash_asp /
--                                 (1 + cal_asp_change_perct), 2))
-- =====================================================================
ADJUSTED_ASP AS (
  SELECT
    j.*,
    IF(j.cal_asp_change_perct = -1, 0,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(j.cal_store_flash_asp,
                         1 + j.cal_asp_change_perct), 2))
      AS cal_asp_adj_amount
  FROM Join_4 j
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 18: Join_5
-- Logic: Left-outer-joins the full VARIANCES dataset with ADJUSTED_ASP
--        on prctr + bic_zio_sweek to bring store-level ASP metrics into
--        the variance dataset. Implements XML Join_5 (joinType=leftOuter,
--        keys=PRCTR + bic_zio_sweek).
-- Source: VARIANCES (left), ADJUSTED_ASP (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN VARIANCES v JOIN ADJUSTED_ASP a
--       USING (prctr, bic_zio_sweek)
-- =====================================================================
Join_5 AS (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    a.cal_store_flash_asp,
    a.cal_total_budget_asp,
    a.cal_total_flash_asp,
    a.cal_asp_change_perct,
    a.cal_asp_adj_amount
  FROM VARIANCES v
  LEFT JOIN ADJUSTED_ASP a
    USING (prctr, bic_zio_sweek)
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 19: BUDGET_ALLOCATION
-- Logic: Computes the allocated RX budget per row. If a row has no
--        pre-allocated RX budget (rx_budget = 0 or NULL), the allocated
--        amount is derived from the SKF budget quantity multiplied by the
--        adjusted ASP; otherwise the pre-allocated RX budget is used.
-- Source: Join_5
-- Calculation:
--   cal_rx_budget_allocated = IF(rx_budget = 0 OR rx_budget IS NULL,
--                                ROUND(skf_budget_qty *
--                                      cal_asp_adj_amount, 2),
--                                rx_budget)
-- =====================================================================
BUDGET_ALLOCATION AS (
  SELECT
    j.*,
    IF(j.rx_budget = 0 OR j.rx_budget IS NULL,
       ROUND(j.skf_budget_qty * j.cal_asp_adj_amount, 2),
       j.rx_budget)
      AS cal_rx_budget_allocated
  FROM Join_5 j
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 20: EXCLUDE_PREALLOCATED
-- Logic: Selects only rows that have a comp flag (budget_comp_flag IS NOT
--        NULL) and no pre-allocated RX budget (rx_budget = 0 or NULL).
--        These rows feed the comp-level budget aggregation. Exposes the
--        allocated amount as cal_rx_budget_comp_level.
-- Source: BUDGET_ALLOCATION
-- Filters: budget_comp_flag IS NOT NULL
--          AND (rx_budget = 0 OR rx_budget IS NULL)
-- =====================================================================
EXCLUDE_PREALLOCATED AS (
  SELECT
    budget_comp_flag,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    cal_rx_budget_allocated AS cal_rx_budget_comp_level
  FROM BUDGET_ALLOCATION
  WHERE budget_comp_flag IS NOT NULL
    AND (rx_budget = 0 OR rx_budget IS NULL)
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 21: COMP_LEVEL_ALLOCATED_BUDGET
-- Logic: Aggregates the comp-level allocated budget at the
--        cal_profit_center + bic_zio_sweek grain. The profit center is
--        derived from the comp flag: '1' → '0000502656', else →
--        '0000502657'. This CTE is required because its output is joined
--        back to BUDGET_ALLOCATION in Join_6 on a derived key.
-- Source: EXCLUDE_PREALLOCATED
-- Aggregation: SUM(cal_rx_budget_comp_level);
--              GROUP BY cal_profit_center, bic_zio_sweek
-- Calculation:
--   cal_profit_center = IF(budget_comp_flag='1','0000502656','0000502657')
-- =====================================================================
COMP_LEVEL_ALLOCATED_BUDGET AS (
  SELECT
    IF(budget_comp_flag = '1', '0000502656', '0000502657')
      AS cal_profit_center,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    SUM(cal_rx_budget_comp_level) AS cal_rx_budget_comp_level
  FROM EXCLUDE_PREALLOCATED
  GROUP BY cal_profit_center, bic_zio_sweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 22: Join_6
-- Logic: Left-outer-joins BUDGET_ALLOCATION with
--        COMP_LEVEL_ALLOCATED_BUDGET on prctr = cal_profit_center AND
--        bic_zio_sweek. Implements XML Join_6 (joinType=leftOuter;
--        second input maps CAL_PROFIT_CENTER to target PRCTR).
-- Source: BUDGET_ALLOCATION (left), COMP_LEVEL_ALLOCATED_BUDGET (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on b.prctr = c.cal_profit_center
--                AND b.bic_zio_sweek = c.bic_zio_sweek
-- =====================================================================
Join_6 AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    c.cal_rx_budget_comp_level
  FROM BUDGET_ALLOCATION b
  LEFT JOIN COMP_LEVEL_ALLOCATED_BUDGET c
    ON  b.prctr          = c.cal_profit_center
    AND b.bic_zio_sweek  = c.bic_zio_sweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 23: DIFFERENCE_ADJUSTMENT
-- Logic: Computes the final RX budget figures. For profit centers
--        '0000502656' or '0000502657' with a comp flag of '0' or '1',
--        the final budget is the difference between the pre-allocated RX
--        budget and the comp-level allocated budget (to avoid double-
--        counting). For all other rows the allocated budget is used
--        directly. Also computes the comp-level RX budget amount.
--        Excludes cal_rx_budget from the pass-through (EXCEPT clause)
--        because it is superseded by cal_rx_budget_final.
-- Source: Join_6
-- Calculation:
--   cal_rx_budget_final =
--     IF(prctr IN ('0000502656','0000502657')
--        AND budget_comp_flag IN ('0','1'),
--        rx_budget - COALESCE(cal_rx_budget_comp_level, 0),
--        cal_rx_budget_allocated)
--   cal_comp_rx_budget_amount =
--     IF(budget_comp_flag = '1', cal_rx_budget_final, 0)
-- =====================================================================
DIFFERENCE_ADJUSTMENT AS (
  SELECT
    j.* EXCEPT (cal_rx_budget),
    IF(
      j.prctr IN ('0000502656', '0000502657')
      AND j.budget_comp_flag IN ('0', '1'),
      j.rx_budget - COALESCE(j.cal_rx_budget_comp_level, 0),
      j.cal_rx_budget_allocated
    ) AS cal_rx_budget_final,
    IF(
      j.budget_comp_flag = '1',
      IF(
        j.prctr IN ('0000502656', '0000502657')
        AND j.budget_comp_flag IN ('0', '1'),
        j.rx_budget - COALESCE(j.cal_rx_budget_comp_level, 0),
        j.cal_rx_budget_allocated
      ),
      0
    ) AS cal_comp_rx_budget_amount
  FROM Join_6 j
)

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL SELECT
-- Logic: Applies the logical-model output layer above DIFFERENCE_ADJUSTMENT.
--        Adds descriptive labels for cal_comp_flag and emerg_mkt_ind, and
--        computes all comp-level variance measures. All column names are in
--        BigQuery style. The d.* expands all columns from
--        DIFFERENCE_ADJUSTMENT; explicit calculated columns follow.
-- Source: DIFFERENCE_ADJUSTMENT
-- Calculation:
--   cal_comp_flag_desc         = CASE cal_comp_flag WHEN '1' THEN 'Comp'
--                                  WHEN '0' THEN 'Non-Comp' ELSE '' END
--   emerg_mkt_ind_desc         = IF(emerg_mkt_ind='Y','Yes',
--                                   IF(emerg_mkt_ind='N','No',''))
--   cal_comp_fs_var_budget     = cal_comp_fs_salesamount
--                                - cal_comp_fs_budget_amount
--   cal_comp_fs_var_fcst       = IF(fs_rx_flag='FS',
--                                   cal_comp_fs_salesamount
--                                   - cal_comp_forecast_amount, 0)
--   cal_comp_fs_var_ly         = IF(fs_rx_flag='FS',
--                                   cal_comp_fs_salesamount
--                                   - cal_comp_ly_amount, 0)
--   cal_comp_rx_var_budget     = cal_comp_rx_salesamount
--                                - cal_comp_rx_budget_amount
--   cal_comp_rx_var_fcst       = IF(fs_rx_flag_ext='RX',
--                                   cal_comp_rx_salesamount
--                                   - cal_comp_forecast_amount, 0)
--   cal_comp_rx_var_ly         = IF(fs_rx_flag_ext='RX',
--                                   cal_comp_rx_salesamount
--                                   - cal_comp_ly_amount, 0)
--   cal_comp_flash_var_fcst    = cal_comp_flash_90as3
--                                - cal_comp_forecast_90as3
--   cal_comp_flash_var_budget  = cal_comp_flash_90as3
--                                - cal_comp_budget_90as3
--   cal_comp_flash_var_ly      = cal_comp_flash_90as3
--                                - cal_comp_ly_90as3
--   cal_comp_corpfs_var_budget = cal_comp_corpfs_sales_amount
--                                - cal_comp_fs_budget_amount
--   cal_comp_corpfs_var_fcst   = IF(fs_rx_flag='FS',
--                                   cal_comp_corpfs_sales_amount
--                                   - cal_comp_forecast_amount, 0)
--   cal_comp_corpfs_var_ly     = IF(fs_rx_flag='FS',
--                                   cal_comp_corpfs_sales_amount
--                                   - cal_comp_ly_amount, 0)
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  d.*,
  CASE d.cal_comp_flag
    WHEN '1' THEN 'Comp'
    WHEN '0' THEN 'Non-Comp'
    ELSE ''
  END AS cal_comp_flag_desc,
  IF(d.emerg_mkt_ind = 'Y', 'Yes',
     IF(d.emerg_mkt_ind = 'N', 'No', '')) AS emerg_mkt_ind_desc,
  d.cal_comp_fs_salesamount - d.cal_comp_fs_budget_amount
    AS cal_comp_fs_var_budget,
  IF(d.fs_rx_flag = 'FS',
     d.cal_comp_fs_salesamount - d.cal_comp_forecast_amount, 0)
    AS cal_comp_fs_var_fcst,
  IF(d.fs_rx_flag = 'FS',
     d.cal_comp_fs_salesamount - d.cal_comp_ly_amount, 0)
    AS cal_comp_fs_var_ly,
  d.cal_comp_rx_salesamount - d.cal_comp_rx_budget_amount
    AS cal_comp_rx_var_budget,
  IF(d.fs_rx_flag_ext = 'RX',
     d.cal_comp_rx_salesamount - d.cal_comp_forecast_amount, 0)
    AS cal_comp_rx_var_fcst,
  IF(d.fs_rx_flag_ext = 'RX',
     d.cal_comp_rx_salesamount - d.cal_comp_ly_amount, 0)
    AS cal_comp_rx_var_ly,
  d.cal_comp_flash_90as3 - d.cal_comp_forecast_90as3
    AS cal_comp_flash_var_fcst,
  d.cal_comp_flash_90as3 - d.cal_comp_budget_90as3
    AS cal_comp_flash_var_budget,
  d.cal_comp_flash_90as3 - d.cal_comp_ly_90as3
    AS cal_comp_flash_var_ly,
  d.cal_comp_corpfs_sales_amount - d.cal_comp_fs_budget_amount
    AS cal_comp_corpfs_var_budget,
  IF(d.fs_rx_flag = 'FS',
     d.cal_comp_corpfs_sales_amount - d.cal_comp_forecast_amount, 0)
    AS cal_comp_corpfs_var_fcst,
  IF(d.fs_rx_flag = 'FS',
     d.cal_comp_corpfs_sales_amount - d.cal_comp_ly_amount, 0)
    AS cal_comp_corpfs_var_ly
FROM DIFFERENCE_ADJUSTMENT d;
